The Little Fawn Who Wandered: Always Stay in Sight! — Daisy the fawn chased a sparkly blue butterfly away from the herd! What should you do if you look up and can't see mom?
Kids science answer for "safety awareness staying with parents kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

The big grocery store or park is exciting, but holding hands or staying where parents can see you keeps you safe from getting lost.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
